title: MAISON BOULEDOGUE — Collection Grotesque
look: Flat-vector paper cutout x 1960s Saul Bass / UPA fashion illustration. Bold silhouettes, thick ink outlines that 'boil', limited palette, paper grain, halftone shadows, gradient rim light. Characters animate on twos (pose changes every 2 frames), camera on ones.
rules: Every color must come from palette via src/lib/style.ts — no hard-coded hex anywhere else.
No Math.random / Date — only seeded helpers in src/lib/rng.ts.
No linear easing on character motion. Anticipation -> action -> overshoot -> settle.
Dangling accessories (earrings, crystals, pearls, tassels, feathers) use damped springs from src/lib/motion.ts.
Pose changes on twos: use onTwos(frame) for character poses; camera and particles use raw frame.
Grotesque = absurd scale and accessory excess, never gore.
